notes.title: Bug fixes and Future updates
notes.content:
Fixed bug causing infinite death.
Fixed Level 9 to work as intended, player resets level if they die anywhere on the level.

Future Updates/Work in Progress: Endless mode. For replayability adding an endless mode to allow players to run through a world trying to get as far as possible and collect as many whiskers as possible all in one life. There will be achievements linked to this as well.
